title: Search words
subtitle: What people searched for in vain, and what they opened next. The site adds a word by itself once the evidence is strong; the rest waits for you.
failed: That did not work. Try again.
lookupNothing: Wikidata does not know “{word}”. Add it by hand or dismiss it.
addAll: Add in all four languages to “{category}”
note: An added word is kept in the category's own list and survives a taxonomy update. You can remove it from the category itself.
